query: SELECT link_id, is_sent, is_draft, (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM email_mailbox_drafts d WHERE d.message_id = email_messages.id AND d.delete_requested) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM email_draft_transfers t WHERE t.source_id=email_messages.id AND t.state<>'preparing')) AS "deleted!" FROM email_messages WHERE id = $1 FOR UPDATE
